narration: The architecture begins with visual conditioning: past motion frames capture head pose dynamics, while an identity frame provides the subject's facial appearance.
A noise-corrupted target frame is combined with the motion and identity frames through a channel concatenation operator.
Concurrently, the input speech waveform is windowed and processed by an audio encoder to extract acoustic and phonetic features.
The central diffusion model receives the concatenated visual features, audio representations, and diffusion time encoding to perform iterative denoising.
Finally, the diffusion process synthesizes the clear, audio-synchronized target frame of the speaking subject.
